description: Story 24.2 / 24.3 — export of ONE Bref owner by api-bref for the Keevo migration tool (format 1). Produced by api-bref (GET /v1/admin/migration/owners/:id/export, superadmin, owner frozen — story 24.1, built by the Bref team), read by Keevo (keevo/backend/src/main/java/com/keevo/migration/adapter/out/source/JsonExportBrefSource.java). One JSON object per owner; property names are the api-bref entity property names (TypeORM, camelCase) so each row is the entity serialized as is. Change this file only with both sides; a breaking change bumps formatVersion (Keevo refuses an unknown version).

transport.file: owner-<owner uuid>.json in the folder keevo.migration.bref.export-dir (Keevo server)
transport.checksum: owner-<owner uuid>.json.sha256 next to it: lower-case hex SHA-256 of the file's exact bytes, optionally followed by whitespace and the file name (sha256sum format). The HTTP export sends the same value in the header X-Bref-Export-Sha256. Missing or different → Keevo answers 422 MIGRATION_EXPORT_INVALID.
transport.encoding: UTF-8 JSON, one top-level object; sections in any order; unknown sections are skipped (streaming)

types.instant: ISO-8601 with offset, UTC ("2026-11-03T21:33:48.123Z"), milliseconds; null when absent
types.decimal: JSON string with a dot ("12500.00") — never a float (24.3–24.5 sections)

owner.description: the owner's user row (role must be "owner", id = the requested owner)

fields.password: string|null (bcrypt hash as stored, $2b$…; null for code / social sign-in)
fields.plan: string (informative: the plan in force is computed from subscriptions by 24.5)

shops.description: EVERY shop whose userId is the owner, soft-deleted ones included (deletedAt set)

fields.name: string
fields.photoData: object|null — optional embedded logo {"contentType": "image/png", "base64": "…"}; when present Keevo uses it instead of downloading photoUrl

members.description: EVERY user whose shopId is one of the owner's shops (roles admin, seller, viewer), soft-deleted ones included; same fields as owner
members.fields: as owner (role: admin | seller | viewer; shopId: the member's shop uuid; password: bcrypt hash)

customers.description: 24.3 — EVERY customer whose shopId is one of the owner's shops (one row per shop and phone)

products.description: 24.3 — EVERY product whose shopId is one of the owner's shops (any case), archived and merged ones included

sections.invoices: 24.4 — array of invoice rows, each with items[] and payments[]

keevoMapping24_2.owner: public.users (same id, bcrypt copied, phone E.164) + a new tenant SUSPENDED until activation (24.9), sale flow DOCUMENT, no « Ma Boutique »
keevoMapping24_2.shops: tenant stores (same ids, dates kept; deleted → inactive), logos through the store logo use case
keevoMapping24_2.members: public.users + memberships (admin → MANAGER, seller → EMPLOYEE, viewer → VIEWER) + employees (id = user id); deleted members are not imported
keevoMapping24_2.blocking: an owner whose phone / email / username (or a member's) already belongs to a Keevo account is not imported (case ACCOUNT_EXISTS, bridge = 24.7)

keevoMapping24_3.categories: the root categories of the sector template (sector of the oldest shop) + « Produits importés » (custom), once per tenant
keevoMapping24_3.products: ONE untracked Keevo product per productKey across the owner's shops (id, name, creation date of the oldest; price of the latest typed price, else of the latest sale, cents rounded); merged products (mergedIntoId) imported archived and redirected; names made unique with « (2) »…; category « Produits importés »; every Bref product traced
keevoMapping24_3.customers: one Keevo client per customer (same id) in the store of its shop (ADR-08: no merge across stores, sharing off); E.164 phone required (else blocking case CLIENT_INVALID); fields beyond the client limits cut or dropped with a note
keevoMapping24_3.blocking: a product or customer of another shop or duplicated, a price out of range (PRODUCT_INVALID), a customer phone not readable as E.164 (CLIENT_INVALID)
